question.en: Discuss the role of UNIDO in fostering sustainable industrialization in developing economies.
question.hi: Discuss the role of UNIDO in fostering sustainable industrialization in developing economies.

modelAnswer.en: UNIDO plays a critical role by providing technical assistance, policy advice, and capacity building. It focuses on three pillars: poverty reduction, trade capacity building, and energy/environment. It helps nations transition to green industries and integrate into global value chains.
